handback.title: Delete dead code from the old label flow
handback.summary: Deletes code left from the old label flow and Dokima's own repo, which nothing calls.
handback.feature: Dead code goes, one story per file area: plan reader, planner steps, fence, card lookups, labels, test finder, card sample.

stories.title: Delete the old label approval and plan parser
stories.user_story: Card draws and scans fetch only the issue's text and link, and the old plan reader is gone.
stories.context: All in `dokima/plan.py`. `fetch_issue` is called by `dokima/card.py:999` and `dokima/scan.py:27`; both read only `current_body`, `url`, `number` and `title`, so keep those keys. No code reads `plan`, `changes` or `approved_at`. Keep `approvers`, `repo_approvers`, `pr_issue_number` and the card markers (`CARD_START`, `CARD_END`), which `dokima/card.py` uses. `main` keeps only `approvers`, which `agent.yml`, `commands.yml` and `assign.yml` call. Tests that only exercise the deleted code: `tests/test_plan.py` (label approval), `tests/test_terms.py` (parser), the `as_text` test in `tests/test_card.py`. Many card tests build fake issues with `plan.parse(...)`, `approved_at` and `changes` keys (`tests/test_card_bullets.py`, `tests/test_card_records.py`, `tests/test_body.py`, `tests/test_open_ask.py`, `tests/test_planner.py`): rewrite those fixtures, do not delete those tests. Module docstring describes label approval; rewrite it.

acceptance_criteria.words: Keep the body and url fetch.

stories.title: Cards stop looking up old work branches and worker runs
stories.user_story: Each redraw stops asking GitHub about old work branches and old worker runs.
stories.context: The owner asks for these `dokima/card.py` changes explicitly. Work branch lookups: `dokima/agent_github.py:26` (`linked_prs`), `:72` (the `issue_of_pr` docstring and pattern), `dokima/card.py:655` (`issue_pr`). Keep `try/issue-N`. Run title: `find_work` at `dokima/card.py:671-673`; `card.yml:107` still sets `RUN_TITLE`, which is harmless, and workflows are not to be changed. Worker runs: `latest_worker_run` at `dokima/card.py:684-687` and its use in `gather` at `:754`; `render` reads `found["worker"]` for the links row, so make that optional. Overlaps open issues #515 and #681. Tests touching it: `tests/test_card_records.py` (the worker.yml fake at 309, the work branch test at 378), `tests/test_card_status.py:476`, `tests/test_body.py:119`, `tests/card_player.py:659`.
